experiment_template.research_question: Does one-shot recycle-boundary state improve native ContextBench selection while avoiding repeated state input and recycle amplification?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycle-boundary presentation.
Any within-round task, source, prompt, cap or threshold change.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells and retains every outcome.

records.falsifier: Any generation receives more than one presentation, any recycled generation receives none, state facts or receipt bindings are invalid, aggregate state-arm tokens do not fall below round nine, valid/file outcomes degrade, or paired native span F1 gain remains below 0.05.
records.mechanism: For each newly selected recycler generation, construct and inject the fitted receipt-bound projection on only the first dispatched request. Record that generation as presented only after the matching model receipt; omit state on later requests until another recycle creates a new generation.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Presenting receipt-bound task state exactly once at each recycle boundary preserves useful continuity while removing repeated state-token input and recycle amplification.

experiment_template.research_question: Does delta-only state outperform one-shot full boundary state?
stop_conditions: A delta contains an unobserved fact.
A required historical fact becomes unavailable.

records.falsifier: Delta omission removes evidence later needed, creates false completion, or fails to improve native outcomes per model token.
records.mechanism: Track the last presented fact identities per generation lineage and project only new evidence and outcomes after the boundary handoff, retaining the objective digest and explicit recovery handles.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A receipt-bound delta containing only facts added since the prior presentation preserves continuity with fewer model tokens than replaying the full state.

experiment_template.research_question: Does one-shot boundary state produce no native benefit over no-state control?

records.falsifier: One-shot boundary state achieves the frozen paired native gain without correctness or integrity regression.
records.mechanism: The model can retrieve observed evidence after recycling, but deterministic process facts do not add the semantic judgment needed to select correct spans.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Receipt-bound process state cannot improve these native outcomes because semantic evidence interpretation is the limiting factor.

selection.reason: Round nine recorded 52 repeated within-generation presentations and 42,681 repeated state tokens. H19 removes that observed mechanism before adding semantic content; H20 retains a smaller-state alternative and H0 preserves the semantic-ceiling explanation.
